# Stellar TimeLock

> Non-custodial Android wallet for time-locking XLM (Stellar Lumens) and other Stellar assets with Soroban smart contracts: time-lock vaults, cooling-off withdrawals and vesting schedules.

No third-party audit is claimed. Nothing on this site is financial advice.

## Contracts

- xlm_vault, testnet: CBIXRLC5GQ6O5UUJFVRIWZD77P5LUVJG3XGGUVS4EWHAJ6LXQZNKH35Z
- xlm_vault, mainnet: CCWDMIPD4ZTTIV5LR53PD325MS6VRGF3WJEJRKNCIKK3G7H6AXJ3UE4F
- multi_asset_vault_v2, testnet: CAHAQAN6KYAQCJ34W6CVZJGMWRXKCZFHM32F37E4EFEIIC4636TD74BV
- multi_asset_vault_v2, mainnet: CAPXQVGAD2TZNEDKZZDX3YKUBHQ2UI2XDI5AND6Z35D2YY2NZ7AJV6LM
